# Abdul Wahab

> AI-powered full-stack and mobile app developer and engineering lead. Works as a one-person product team: design, websites, iOS and Android apps, backends, AWS cloud, data and AI features. 10+ years in production across e-commerce, grocery delivery and logistics. Remote from Pakistan (UTC+5), working with teams worldwide.

## Highlights
- Engineering Lead at GrocerApp (2026–present): led the full redesign of the website, iOS app and Android app; upgraded Laravel across all backend codebases; cut monthly AWS cost 68% ($2,500 to $800).
- Senior Software Engineer at DeftShip (2022–2026): scaled a shipping platform to 100,000 orders/day at peak; integrated 15+ e-commerce marketplaces.
- Team Lead at GrocerApp (2021–2022): led a team of 6 across Android, iOS, backend and DevOps.
- Uses AI tools (Claude Code, Claude API, MCP) in daily engineering work; built an Urdu voice-ordering flow with Whisper and the Claude API.
- Upwork Top Rated: 5.0 rating, 100% job success, 3,500+ hours.
